title: Nostalgic Sweet Chinese Kippers Tagine
description: A sweet and dense Chinese-inspired dish featuring kippers, deep-fried in agemono style, and cooked in a tagine pot, lacto-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the flaked kippers in agemono style until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the kippers from the oil and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same oil, fry the chopped onion until translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the oil and fry for an additional minute.
In a tagine pot, combine the fried onion mixture, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the deep-fried kippers to the tagine pot and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine pot and cook over low heat for 20 minutes.
Serve the nostalgic sweet Chinese kippers tagine hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
